patterns.pattern: Always read Hetzner VPS IP from the sync-and-deploy workflow file, never rely on conversation memory
patterns.detail: The Hetzner IP can change (e.g., server rebuild, IP reassignment). The canonical source is .agent/workflows/sync-and-deploy.md. If SSH times out, check Hetzner Console at https://console.hetzner.com/
patterns.evolution_marker: Initial creation from deploy failure due to stale IP

patterns.pattern: Docker Compose service names differ from container names. Use 'bot' (not 'shamrock-bot') in docker compose commands
patterns.detail: docker compose commands use service names from docker-compose.yml (bot, dashboard, health, db). Container names (shamrock-bot, shamrock-dashboard, etc.) are used in docker logs/exec but NOT in compose up/down/build.
patterns.evolution_marker: Initial creation from 'no such service: shamrock-bot' error

patterns.pattern: Multiple defensive filters in series create a deadlock where no trades pass. Audit the full filter chain before deployment
patterns.detail: Fibonacci hard gate + Capital Recovery throttle + high min_gem_score + tight Kelly clamps + strict RugCheck floor combined to reject 100% of trades. Each filter alone was reasonable but the cascade blocked everything. Convert hard blocks to soft penalties where possible.
patterns.evolution_marker: Initial creation from zero-trade audit session

patterns.pattern: Market regime filters (Fibonacci, trend, volatility) should apply score penalties rather than hard blocks
patterns.detail: A hard block in pullback market = zero trades for extended periods. A soft penalty (-15 points) still filters weak entries but allows strong gems to pass through pullback environments.
patterns.evolution_marker: Initial creation from Fibonacci gate audit
